checks.title: Confirm payables role
checks.instructions: Confirm entity, owner, and whether this is the primary Crew role or a supporting pack. Preserve an existing identity and record payment authority separately.

checks.title: Verify the payables skill
checks.instructions: Confirm skills/spend-payables-coordinator/SKILL.md exists and spend-payables-coordinator is selected for this Crew.

checks.title: Agree on spend and purchase policy
checks.instructions: Confirm approval levels, budget owners, purchase criteria, security/privacy gates, required PO/receipt evidence, vendor verification, duplicate criteria, and payment boundaries. Record stable decisions in MEMORY.md.

checks.title: Verify source records
checks.instructions: Identify authoritative vendor/AP and budget sources. Read a representative authorized bill/expense or purchase request and current vendor record for the agreed entity and currency. A file is sufficient; a connector is optional. Note missing purchase or payment status.

checks.title: Map exact vendor and money fields
checks.instructions: For a bill, verify vendor ID, invoice number, dates, amount, currency, PO/contract, approval and paid/scheduled state. For a proposed purchase, verify request, product, plan, quote revision, seats, term, all fees and total against the validated comparison. Keep a quote, PO, bill, card charge and payment distinct.

checks.title: Test duplicate and policy checks
checks.instructions: For one actual bill, join original document hash/version to AP by entity, vendor and invoice ID; recheck near duplicates, credits, partial payments, approvals and paid/scheduled state. For one proposed purchase, bind the exact comparison and re-read current vendor register, overlapping subscriptions and POs, remaining budget, security/privacy dispositions and approver policy. Preserve source revisions, false-match caveats and changed bank-detail warnings. Obtain the owner's decision before claiming either route is ready, approved or paid.

checks.title: Review the first purchase or payables result
checks.instructions: Produce a dated, source-linked purchase decision or payables queue with exact plan or bill, amount/currency, status, approver, policy reason, and evidence gaps. Complete after the owner reviews a representative result.

checks.title: Decide where the queue goes
checks.instructions: Choose Crew chat or an approved destination. Chat-only completes this decision. Verify recipient and privacy before any delivery.

checks.title: Decide on recurring review
checks.instructions: Choose chat-only, a schedule, or authenticated bill event. Chat-only completes this decision. Test source freshness and duplicate handling before enabling recurrence.
